chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah said:
He said: "The witnesses of false testimony are flogged with a flogging that has no fixed time, and that is at the discretion of the Imam, and they are paraded until the people recognize them."
As for the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'And do not accept any testimony from them ever' ... 'Except those who repent' (1)
I asked: "How is their repentance known?" He said: "He lies to himself where he is being struck and seeks forgiveness of his Lord. When he does that, his repentance has become evident."

key_terms.إِلَى الْإِمَامِ: At the discretion of the Imam
key_terms.جَلْدٌ غِلْظٌ: A flogging with no fixed time/discretionary duration

ai.seo_question: What is the specific punishment and sign of repentance for witnesses of false testimony in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the disciplinary punishment (*ta'zir*) for false witnesses, emphasizing the Imam's discretion in determining the severity and duration of flogging. It uniquely links the acceptance of repentance to a physical manifestation of humility, where the witness lies during the beating while seeking forgiveness, thereby validating their sincerity through endurance of pain.
